content: Any strategic decision-making within this domain will increasingly rely on leveraging targeted innovations that address the specific needs of these diverse client segments, ensuring that the remarkable safety milestones achieved over the past three decades are not only maintained but continuously improved upon. Proposed amendments discussed extensively in legal reviews, including a notable 2020 analysis, highlighted a strategic shift toward heightened employer accountability. Among the most significant proposals was the introduction of a new legal offense penalizing employers who fail to take reasonable steps to ensure the health and safety of their workforce, a measure widely considered a crucial step forward in promoting safer work environments and deterring negligence [29] .
